Generate spatial and temporal covariates at sf locations

Source: R/spacetime.R
calculate_spacetime.Rd

Writes the 61 covariates from the hourly PM2.5 benchmark for every supplied location, date, and time of day. Spatial and temporal features are calculated separately before DuckDB expands their combinations directly into Parquet.

Usage

calculate_spacetime(
  locs,
  date,
  output,
  trend,
  hour = 0:23,
  locs_id = "site_id",
  tz = "UTC",
  threads = 1L,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

locs

An sf object with a defined CRS and one row per location. Points are used directly. Polygon and multipolygon locations are represented by their centroids, calculated in the supplied CRS using sf::st_centroid(). Supply points when a particular grid-cell centre is required.

date

A vector of Date values, YYYY-MM-DD strings, or YYYYMMDD strings, as returned by amadeus::sequence_dates(). Every supplied date is used; a two-element vector is not expanded into a date range.

output

Character(1). Destination .parquet file.

trend

Two dates defining the start and exclusive end of the linear trend reference period. For the original 2024–2025 benchmark, use c("2024-01-01", "2026-01-01"). Reuse the same values for training, prediction, and every processing batch; they are not inferred from date.

hour

Numeric hours from 0 through 23, or character times in HHMM, HH:MM, or HH:MM:SS format. Defaults to all 24 hourly points. Character times can also represent subhourly points from amadeus time sequences.

locs_id

Character(1). Column containing unique, nonmissing location IDs. Its name and values are retained in the output.

tz

Character(1). Time zone of the supplied dates and hours. Defaults to "UTC", matching the current training and grid indices. Temporal covariates use this clock; the output time represents the corresponding UTC instant. No location-specific time zone is inferred. The benchmark used local clock values, so reproduce that convention explicitly when comparing its results. Repeated daylight-saving hours are not expanded; nonexistent times are rejected. UTC avoids daylight-saving ambiguity.

threads

Positive integer. Number of DuckDB worker threads.

overwrite

Logical. Whether to replace an existing output file.

Value

The normalized output path. The Parquet file contains locs_id, time, and 61 numeric covariate columns. Row order is not guaranteed.

Details

The output contains 21 spatial features (coordinates, equirectangular and spherical coordinates, ten broad and four local radial basis functions), 36 temporal features (eight diurnal, three weekly, and six annual sine/cosine pairs plus linear and quadratic trends), and four coordinate-by-annual-cycle interactions. Knot locations, bandwidths, feature names, and formulas match inst/devel/07_prepare_hourly_pm25_benchmark.R.

Weekly and annual phases use 2024-01-01 as their fixed origin. Trend values outside the reference period are extrapolated, not clipped. No observations, response values, or fold assignments are required. Input IDs, dates, and hours must each be unique to prevent duplicate location-time keys.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dates <- amadeus::sequence_dates(c("2018-01-01", "2018-01-31"))
reference <- c("2018-01-01", "2020-01-01")
calculate_spacetime(
  sf_train_sites_sp, dates, "output/train/spacetime.parquet",
  trend = reference
)
calculate_spacetime(
  sf_grid_sites_sp, dates, "output/grid/spacetime.parquet",
  trend = reference
)
} # }
